title: Product Manager (12 month FTC)
description: <p>Product at HelloFresh is exciting. We’re talking recipe ranges, box types and, or product additions such as our surcharge portfolio (range of value added recipes that customers can pay extra for to acquire).  Reporting directly into our Head of Menu Strategy and Product Development,  you will sit at the vital intersection of customer, operations and web-development. Without this team, we can’t stay number one globally and so we want someone to come in and use their energy, passion and outstanding project management to help us continue to give customers the best products in the market.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategically own and manage the end-to-end range and assortment planning for Surcharge (HelloFresh and GC) and Market for HelloFresh UK.</strong> This involves significant collaboration with the global HFM team, who manage much of the strategic planning, to ensure local execution aligns with global initiatives while driving basket penetration and safeguarding high-margin revenue streams.</li> <li><strong>Lead performance reporting and tracking </strong>across all value-added revenue streams, utilizing data-driven insights to optimize product performance, drive margin growth, and identify opportunities for AOV and basket expansion.</li> <li><strong>Drive innovation by curating and sourcing new concepts, premium recipes, and high-performing Market additions</strong> that enhance customer value perception and complement our core meal kit offering.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate closely with the culinary team </strong>to translate new product concepts and insights into tangible, appealing recipes that align with our surcharge and market strategies.</li> <li><strong>Own the process for new SKU proposals, forecasting, and assortment refinement</strong>, bridging the gap between innovation and commercial viability to ensure every addition contributes to long-term profitability.</li> <li><strong>Work cross-functionally </strong>to ensure flawless execution of the product innovation roadmap for value added products, playing a key role in helping shape the future of HelloFresh UK’s premium product strategy.</li> <li><strong>Partner with Product Marketing and Brand teams </strong>to build compelling commercial stories for value-added products, maximizing customer lifetime value through targeted initiatives.</li> <li>Being a champion for your customers within the business</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>3-5 years’ experience within either a commercial FMCG role, such as brand / category management (e-commerce experience is a bonus), or a top tier consultancy within these industries</li> <li>Outstanding project management skills, and the ability to keep the plates spinning</li> <li>Able to work cross-functionally to drive through product initiatives in a complex structure with global stakeholders</li> <li>Confidence working with data to build business cases and make recommendations to the UK and global teams</li> <li>Customer-centric mindset, including the ability to use data to identify unmet customer needs and pain points</li> <li>Creative thinking to develop solutions that solve our customers’ challenges and an entrepreneurial attitude.</li> <li>Experience is executing digital tests and working with digital products.  </li> <li>Experience in food, e-commerce and digital merchandising would be a bonus.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you will get in return:</strong></span></p> <p>● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes<br>● Company pension scheme<br>● Gym membership<br>● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)<br>● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme<br>● Dog friendly office! (London site only)<br>● Nursery support scheme<br>● Cycle to work scheme<br>● Group Life Assurance</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London </p> <p><strong>To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.</strong></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Hybrid Working Policy</strong><br>We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p><strong>Next steps</strong>: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.</p> <p>You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (<span class="il">DBS</span>) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company. </p> <p>If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive, UK & Ireland Manufacturing
description: The role is remote located in the UK Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology. In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work." We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale. About You: You are driven by new business development and have a proven track record of managing the full sales cycle for SaaS solutions in the manufacturing industry. You are commercially-minded and thrive in environments that are scaling quickly, and you're excited to contribute to building new processes. You have a customer-centric approach, with a genuine desire to listen to and learn from clients and partners. You possess a hands-on mentality and are adept at managing large, complex projects. What skills do I need? 5-7+ years of experience in an Account Executive role, selling complex software solutions into the manufacturing sector. Deep understanding of the UK manufacturing industry is highly desirable. A consistent track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets. Excellent written and oral communications skills Trained/certified in value-selling sales methodologies A positive, can-do attitude is a key quality to succeed on the Tulip team Familiarity with Salesforce.com is a plus; organize / report on all sales productivity on a consistent basis Ability to quickly learn Salesforce, Outreach, Zoominfo, Linkedin Sales Navigator Experience in cross functional collaborations and contributions to building highly functional commercial teams Key Responsibilities: Break into and drive large, complex deals through lead to close. Experience navigating large company procurement processes. Drive account strategies and account plans to execute a sales process and win deals within assigned accounts. Manage multiple customer opportunities with multiple partners at once while maintaining a high level of attention to detail. Build accurate forecasting and an operational cadence with management Drive referenceable customer satisfaction in your accounts Expertly demonstrate Tulip technology to end users and execute opportunities with channel partners. Have passion for technology and speak fluently about current trends related to SaaS, PaaS, IoT, and cloud solutions. Develop champions, stakeholder mind-share, and close at the VP/C-level. Be a planner and lead the preparation of client engagements across internal and partner stakeholders to speed deal cycle times. Leverage and collaborate with internal/external resources as a team player; Professional Services, Pre Sales Engineering, Marketing, Channel Partners, etc. Key Collaborators: Sales Pre Sales Engineering Customer Success Marketing Professional Services Channel and Alliances Working At Tulip We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include: Company equity: Share in the success you help create. Holiday Allowance: Unlimited vacation policy. Learning & Development: A dedicated budget for your professional growth. We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically. description: Senior Product Manager – Consumer Lifecycle Location: London, United Kingdom Employment type: Permanent, full-time, Office first Team description The Consumer Lifecycle team owns the product experience that turns SumUp app signups into active, transacting customers - from onboarding through to first transaction and ongoing engagement. As the sole Product Manager for consumer activation and engagement, you will own that funnel end to end, improving conversion at every stage. What you'll do Own the consumer onboarding funnel end to end: signup, identity verification (KYC), first funding, first transaction and habitual use Identify and ship product improvements at the biggest drop-off points, starting with the gap between KYC completion and first transaction Balance fraud and verification controls with a smooth, user-friendly product experience Run discovery, experimentation and iteration cycles against activation targets, and report progress to consumer leadership You'll be great for this role if… Experience leading a consumer product area with clear commercial and KPI accountability Strong track record of prioritising effectively across competing demands from multiple teams and stakeholders Experience driving engagement or retention within a consumer-facing mobile app used at scale Comfort balancing risk or compliance requirements against a smooth, user-friendly product experience Ability to build strong relationships across engineering, design, data and marketing, and communicate progress clearly to leadership Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our London Bridge location. This role involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn , Instagram , and For more office tour videos and content to add to this job post or your LinkedIn posts, check out the Global Employer Brand video library. title: Director, Mobility Partnerships
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.</p></div><p>As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank’s expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.</p> <p>You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank’s representative within a highly specialized industry. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice</strong></p> <p>Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice <a href="https://pallet.com/privacy">here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations</strong></p> <p>Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. description: <h2>Who Are We?</h2> <p>RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.</p> <p>We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.</p> <p>RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.</p> <h2>Role Overview</h2> <p>As a Senior Growth Manager based in London, you will own a portfolio of strategically significant accounts across the UK and Western EMEA, driving revenue retention and growth for some of the most commercially important relationships in the region. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will operate with full autonomy from day one: leading your own growth plans, managing executive-level client relationships, and executing across the full account lifecycle without co-management.</p> <p>You will work closely with cross-functional teams across Growth, Analytics, and Operations to launch and optimize campaigns, surface performance insights, and translate data into decisions that move the business. You will report to the EMEA Growth lead and collaborate with a lean, senior team that moves fast and holds itself to a high standard.</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of RZR's EMEA strategy. The region manages a combined book of over $110K DRR across 30+ accounts, with a strong new business pipeline, and we need a senior operator who can own a meaningful portion of that portfolio independently and grow it.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Revenue Retention & Growth</h3> <ul> <li>Drive net growth to meet or exceed revenue targets across your assigned portfolio</li> <li>Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities while actively managing churn risk and re-activation plays</li> <li>Drive product adoption and expansion to increase revenue quality and account depth</li> <li>Proactively surface client needs and gaps to inform both account strategy and commercial planning</li> </ul> <h3>Client Ownership & Strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Lead account retention and growth plans with a multi-quarter forward view and clear, measurable milestones</li> <li>Build strong client relationships at all levels, from performance marketers to C-suite stakeholders</li> <li>Use QBRs and strategic sessions to drive progress, deepen engagement, and secure long-term commitment</li> <li>Communicate product capabilities and market changes in ways that are clear, compelling, and directly relevant to each client's business</li> <li>Provide market insights and best practices that position RZR as a strategic partner, not just a vendor</li> </ul> <h3>Campaign Management & Performance Insights</h3> <ul> <li>Work with internal teams to launch, execute, and optimize campaigns aligned to client goals</li> <li>Monitor account health and identify performance issues before they become client concerns</li> <li>Deliver actionable insights tied to business impact, not just metrics</li> <li>Recommend creative and strategy adjustments to counter performance fatigue and sustain growth</li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional Collaboration</h3> <ul> <li>Lead cross-functional coordination to meet client expectations and execute growth plans on time</li> <li>Maintain clear escalation paths to resolve issues quickly and protect the client relationship</li> <li>Conduct client training sessions, platform walkthroughs, and onboarding as needed</li> </ul> <h3>Operational Excellence</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline documentation, and reporting with full personal accountability</li> <li>Ensure financial alignment including timely invoicing and budget tracking</li> <li>Report accurately and consistently to regional EMEA and global leadership</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>3 to 5 years of experience in mobile advertising, including at least 3 years in a client-facing growth or account management role</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of the programmatic advertising ecosystem</li> <li>Familiarity with the UK market; established relationships with key advertisers and agencies across the UK and Western EMEA are a significant advantage</li> <li>Proven ability to build high-touch client relationships, manage in-person engagements, and calibrate the right frequency and depth of contact</li> <li>Track record of independently managing and scaling commercial accounts, identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities without hand-holding</li> <li>Comfortable managing the full account lifecycle in a commercially dense, competitive market</li> <li>Willingness to travel regularly and engage clients and team members in person</li> <li>Ability to adapt quickly in a high-growth environment and lead growth initiatives with limited structural support</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, able to engage confidently with clients from campaign managers to C-level executives</li> <li>Strong collaborator across diverse, globally distributed teams</li> <li>Familiarity with data analytics, machine learning, and advertising technology is a plus</li> <li>Fluent in English; an additional European language is an advantage</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join RZR in London?</h2> <ul> <li>Step into direct ownership of a commercially significant EMEA portfolio from day one: full autonomy, full accountability, and no co-management required</li> <li>Work with a privacy-centric, AI-driven programmatic platform as the UK market deepens and the product portfolio (User Acquisition, Retargeting, CTV) actively expands</li> <li>Earn a competitive base salary plus a title: Social & Content Account Executive - Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Burson Sport, Brand & Entertainment team works with some of the world’s most ambitious consumer brands, helping them earn attention, build cultural relevance and drive conversation across markets. This role will focus on a leading European fashion retailer, creating content for the brand’s social channels.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The team is united by a belief in the power of culture, creativity and influence to shape how people discover, engage with and talk about brands. Across fashion and retail, lifestyle and technology, and food and drink, the team develops work that is insight-led, locally relevant and capable of travelling across multiple markets. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">As an Account Executive (AE) for Social & Content, you are a vital part of our team, developing foundational skills in co</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">ntent, </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">communications</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)"> and client service. </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">Working closely </span></span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Emphasis">with and into</span></span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)"> the Social & Content Manager, you will be instrumental in supporting day-to-day activities, learning industry best practices, and contributing to successful client campaigns. Your role </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">centers</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)"> on </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">social </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">content creation, community engagement, and </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">leveraging</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)"> social </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">data </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">to drive performance.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">We encourage you to bring your creativity, proactivity, and unique perspective to the role, drawing inspiration from your interests to develop fresh ideas and contribute to compelling content strategies. This position offers a prime opportunity for growth, learning, and making a tangible impact on client success within the exciting world of social media and digital content.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Support the day-to-day management of social media campaigns and client communications.</li> <li>Research social trends, emerging formats and cultural moments to inform content planning.</li> <li>Create and edit social content, including copywriting, basic filming and video editing for multiple platforms.</li> <li>Assist with the development and delivery of social content calendars and campaign activations.</li> <li>Coordinate meetings, prepare materials, capture notes and ensure follow-up actions are completed.</li> <li>Monitor campaign performance, conduct social listening and use analytics tools to generate insights.</li> <li>Create visually engaging reports and presentations that communicate campaign results and recommendations.</li> <li>Support account administration, project tracking, budget management and new business opportunities.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of major social platforms, content formats and platform-specific best practices.</li> <li>Experience creating social-first content, including copywriting, filming and editing for digital channels.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.</li> <li>Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.</li> <li>Interest in social media trends, internet culture and the broader digital marketing landscape.</li> <li>Analytical mindset with an interest in social listening, reporting and interpreting performance data.</li> <li>Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across teams and build positive relationships.</li> <li>Proactive, curious and eager to learn, with a willingness to embrace new technologies, including AI tools and platforms.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Experiential Creative Lead - Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Experiential (3D) Creative Lead with extensive creative industry experience.</p> <p>You’ll take a key role in the entire process of creating experiential projects from creative concepting through to production information, making sure our Studio’s creative excellence and client’s vision is brought to life accurately. You create engaging brand experiences that connect audiences to a client’s message, product, or service across physical and digital environments. This role blends creativity, storytelling, and execution leadership.</p> <p>Core to your role is shaping how people feel, move, and interact within a space. You begin by reviewing project briefs and aligning on brand objectives, audience goals, and spatial requirements to establish a strong conceptual foundation. From there, you develop and present design concepts to clients, clearly articulating the vision and incorporating feedback into thoughtful revisions.</p> <p>You coordinate closely with vendors and production partners to ensure designs are feasible and executed to specification, and you conduct site visits to oversee installation and resolve on-site challenges. Overall, your day-to-day work balances creative ideation, design development, technical problem-solving, and hands-on execution to bring immersive environments to life.</p> <p>You’ll build relationships across the wider agency and be capable of adapting to take on a variety of briefs that may require, for example, graphic or brand design expertise. Showing a willingness to ask questions which build a deep understanding of the task ahead.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>In Studio, we create ideas and bring them to life. We’re a multi-disciplined team, creating content for integrated marketing campaigns, brand experiences and brand identity. We currently have a team of around 35; a mix of Creatives, Brand and Digital Designers, Editors and Content Producers and Creative Project Managers, supplemented by freelancers when specialist skills are needed or workload dictates.</p> <p>Everyone that succeeds here enjoys the diversity of clients and projects and is driven to do great work that will have a positive effect on our clients’ businesses.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Translate creative ideas into impactful experiential activations and events. </li> <li>Partner with creative, strategy and client teams from project inception. </li> <li>Lead the design of exhibitions, trade shows, conferences and immersive brand experiences. </li> <li>Develop floor plans, spatial concepts and visualisations that bring ideas to life. </li> <li>Present and defend experiential concepts directly with clients and stakeholders. </li> <li>Ensure alignment between creative vision, production requirements and client objectives. </li> <li>Manage freelance specialists and external partners to deliver high-quality outputs. </li> <li>Provide hands-on creative leadership across global events, activations and healthcare conferences. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <div>Proven experience in experiential, exhibition, or environmental design, ideally delivering projects for consumer brands.</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong ability to develop and deliver creative concepts from initial ideation through to final execution, balancing innovation with brand guidelines.</div> </li> <li> <div>Expertise in creating concept sketches, 3D models, photorealistic renders, and technical design drawings to communicate and realise design ideas.</div> </li> <li> <div>Proficiency in 3D design and visualisation software (e.g. Vectorworks, Cinema4D, 3ds Max, SketchUp) and Adobe Creative Suite.</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including creative, digital, motion, AV, production, and communications specialists, to deliver integrated brand experiences.</div> </li> <li> <div>Sound understanding of materials, fabrication methods, production processes, and sustainable design principles, with a focus on modularity and reuse.</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong client-facing skills, with the ability to present ideas confidently, manage feedback, articulate design rationale, and build trusted relationships.</div> </li> <li> <div>Excellent project management and communication skills, capable of overseeing multiple projects, managing stakeholder expectations, identifying risks, and supporting new business pitches and proposals.</div> </li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Reporting directly to JT Joseph within the Intelligence & Insights practice and based in London, UK (Hybrid working policy), this role is central to leading the technical development of Fount, Burson’s flagship communications intelligence platform.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for translating product vision and technical specifications into robust, scalable data engineering and business intelligence solutions. Working closely with product leadership, you will contribute technical insights and architectural recommendations that help shape the platform's future evolution. You will operate within a structured Agile team managed in Jira, where product vision, priorities and roadmaps are set by Product Owners, while your core focus is executing this vision to the highest engineering standards.</p> <p>You will serve as the lead engineer responsible for building, maintaining and enhancing Fount, Burson’s custom data pipeline and database layer for communications reporting. Fount enables analysts to configure client monitoring subscriptions, Boolean searches, data ingestion and AI enrichment through an analyst-facing configuration layer. Under the direction of product leadership, you will execute technical deliverables that make the platform more reliable, scalable and seamless for non-technical users to configure and operate.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role with technical leadership and mentoring responsibility, rather than a formal people-management position. You will directly mentor a junior engineer while providing technical peer support and alignment across the wider engineering team. The position combines strategic engineering with hands-on delivery across major pillars:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Leadership & Architecture</strong> (e.g., pipeline design, engineering standards, technical reviews, technical debt refactoring, mentoring)</li> <li><strong>Fount Platform & Data Engineering</strong> (e.g., ETL/ELT pipelines, Python services, SQL layers, API integrations, cloud infrastructure, cost & performance optimization)</li> <li><strong>Analyst Enablement & AI Integrations</strong> (e.g., NocoDB configuration, Boolean ingestion, LLM enrichment frameworks, MCP & provider-hosted integrations)</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the technical design, architectural standards, and delivery of business-critical data pipelines, services, and platform components across media monitoring and communications data sources.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Owners in an Agile Jira environment to assess technical feasibility, evaluate trade-offs, and translate product requirements into maintainable, scalable technical solutions.</li> <li>Build and maintain production-ready Python services, SQL transformation layers, star-schema data models, and API integrations across relational databases and cloud storage (Azure Data Lake).</li> <li>Optimise pipeline performance, system reliability, compute efficiency, and AI token costs, while establishing robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident-response practices.</li> <li>Enhance Fount’s analyst-facing configuration layer (Boolean searches, API ingestion rules, NocoDB workflows) to streamline analyst setup and reduce routine engineering intervention.</li> <li>Operationalise AI-enabled enrichment frameworks (classification, summarisation, sentiment, topic detection, LLMs, MCP-enabled integrations) with strict quality assurance, governance, and cost controls.</li> <li>Deliver custom data engineering solutions for specialized client requirements, integrating internal, API-driven, and third-party research datasets into scalable reporting workflows.</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, architectural guidance, and knowledge-sharing, while systematically refactoring technical debt and maintaining operational runbooks.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Substantial experience designing, building, and operating production data platforms, star-schema data models, and complex ELT/ETL pipelines.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, including clean object-oriented design, Pandas, query optimization, and REST API integrations.</li> <li>Hands-on experience within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, ADLS), Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.</li> <li>Proven track record in system reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, logging/monitoring, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability mentoring junior engineers and elevating team capabilities through code reviews, technical standards, and title: Graduate - Scale Space
description: <h1>Graduate Programme — Scale Space</h1> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?</li> <li>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</li> <li>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a growing business operates, while being supported to take ownership of work that matters?</li> </ul> <p class="isSelectedEnd">If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><strong>Scale Space</strong>, one of the businesses within the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio.</p> <h2>ABOUT US</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital, including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets. Ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees supporting their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We work closely with investment and strategic partners including PayPal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, Worldpay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to best-practice tools, solutions and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new businesses get off the ground, including technology, growth, talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <h2>IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and OnSide Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <h2>ABOUT SCALE SPACE</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Scale Space is a community and workspace designed to bring together ambitious businesses, entrepreneurs, scale-ups and innovators.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Based in White City, Scale Space provides more than just flexible workspace. It creates an environment where growing businesses can connect, collaborate and access the networks, expertise and opportunities they need to scale.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The team works across community, events, partnerships, operations and customer experience to ensure that members receive a high-quality experience while helping to build a connected and ambitious business community.</p> <h2>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><strong>Scale Space</strong>.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will be embedded within the Scale Space team and contribute to meaningful projects across the business, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Dedicated to Scale Space</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Scale Space. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Scale Space and its growth, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.</li> <li><strong>Training & Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Scale Space. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Scale Space team.</li> <li><strong>Early Careers Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your substantive role remains fully dedicated to Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Graduate Community</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Accountability</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Scale Space and see the direct impact of your work on the business, its members and the wider community.</li> </ul> <h2>ARE YOU BC?</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech-related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline. Different areas of expertise bring valuable new perspectives.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Curious</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– people in BC are inquisitive. They want to understand ‘why’ and consider whether there is a better approach rather than simply accepting ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– we are a community of proactive self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, but we look for people who can use their initiative, take ownership and drive work forward on a daily basis.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility in order to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. title: Graduate - Babyzone
description: <p>Graduate Programme — Babyzone</p> <ul> <li><strong>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life? </strong></li> <li><strong>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters? </strong></li> </ul> <p>If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p>We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT US</strong></p> <p>At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p>Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong> IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</strong></p> <p>15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <p>ABOUT BABYZONE</p> <p>Babyzone is an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.</p> <p> <strong>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p>For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul> <li>Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.</li> <li>Training & Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.</li> <li>Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.</li> <li>Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.</li> <li>Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>ARE YOU BC? </strong></p> <p>We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives. </p> <p>We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curious </strong>– people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’ </strong>– surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset – </strong>working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm – </strong>you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.</li> </ul> <p>If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:</p> <ul> <li>Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC</li> <li>Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone</li> <li>A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere</li> <li>Discretionary bonus</li> <li>25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off</li> <li>Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>APPLICATION & PROCESS</strong></p> <p>If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. title: People Director - Europe
description: <h2>About the Opportunity</h2> <p>We are looking for a People Director to help lead our Europe business through its next phase of growth. We need someone who can work alongside our European leadership team to shape the business, build leadership capability, retain exceptional talent, and ensure our People strategy evolves ahead of the business. </p> <p>The role will lead the People team across the UK and Portugal and play an important role in connecting Europe to Indicium AI’s global business strategy, People priorities and ways of working. You will represent the needs of the Europe business globally while helping translate our global objectives into regional priorities. </p> <p>Success in this role requires someone who is highly visible in the business, builds credibility and relationships quickly, brings the the confidence and judgment to influence senior leaders, and can introduce the right level of structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. </p> <p>You will lead and develop our existing Europe People team and work closely with our Global People and Talent team. </p> <p>This is a hybrid role with a minimum of three days per week in the office, plus regular travel to Lisbon.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the People strategy across the UK and Portugal, aligned with Europe and global business objectives.</li> <li>Help lead Europe through its next stage of scale, anticipating the organisational, leadership and talent capabilities needed as the business grows.</li> <li>Connect Europe to the global business, translating global priorities into regional People priorities while representing Europe’s needs in global decisions.</li> <li>Build strong, trusted relationships across the business, becoming a credible adviser to leaders on both business and People decisions.</li> <li>Strengthen leadership and management capability, coaching leaders through performance, organisational challenges, change and difficult people decisions.</li> <li>Build and retain exceptional talent, particularly across our technical and consulting teams, through career development, performance, compensation, succession and workforce planning.</li> <li>Support the continued growth of Portugal, ensuring we have the right organisation, leadership, talent practices and culture as the Lisbon team scales.</li> <li>Lead, mentor and develop the Europe People team, creating opportunities for the team to grow while maintaining ownership and autonomy.</li> <li>Build scalable People practices without over-engineering them, continuously improving core People processes, systems, reporting and ways of working as the organisation grows.</li> <li>Lead organisational change and manage People risk, including employee relations and other transformations, balancing employee experience with commercial realities.</li> </ul> <h2>Requirements</h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of progressive People/HR experience, with leadership responsibility and autonomy in a high-growth professional services organisation.</li> <li>Ability to work from our office at 100 Liverpool Street in London, UK and travel to Lisbon, Portugal regularly. </li> <li>Demonstrated experience helping an organisation navigate a meaningful stage of growth, including evolving its organisational structure, leadership capability and People model as the business scales.</li> <li>Strong experience partnering directly with senior executives and the credibility and judgment to influence business and organizational decisions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the dynamics of a professional services organisation, including the relationship between talent, utilisation, capability, client delivery and commercial performance.</li> <li>Experience developing and retaining technical or specialist talent, including career frameworks, performance management, succession planning and compensation.</li> <li>Proven experience leading, title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the Role MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in. We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend. You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you’ll have impact: Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability. Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components. Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies. Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there. Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty. What you’ll bring: 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript. Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals. Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS. Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty. Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices. Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear. An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief. Nice to have: Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up). Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering. Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers. Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission. We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users. title: Senior Platform/Dev Ops Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><div>We are seeking a Senior Platform Enablement / DevOps Engineer to lead the design, scalability, reliability, and evolution of our enterprise developer platform and cloud-native delivery ecosystem.</div> <div><br>This role combines deep technical expertise with platform strategy, operational leadership, and engineering enablement. You will help define standards, modernize deployment practices, improve developer experience, and drive platform reliability across multi-cloud environments.<br>The ideal candidate has strong experience building enterprise-scale CI/CD platforms, Kubernetes ecosystems, Infrastructure as Code, observability solutions, and developer enablement capabilities.</div> <div><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></div> <ul> <li>Architect, build, and evolve scalable platform engineering and DevOps solutions for enterprise engineering teams.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of modern CI/CD and GitOps workflows using Jenkins, Kargo, ArgoCD, GitHub, and related tooling.</li> <li>Drive platform standardization, automation, reliability, and self-service engineering capabilities.</li> <li>Design and manage scalable Infrastructure as Code frameworks using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.</li> <li>Lead Kubernetes platform architecture, Helm-based deployments, and container orchestration best practices.</li> <li>Establish observability standards and operational excellence using Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and related tooling.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering, security, cloud, and architecture teams to improve platform capabilities and developer workflows.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and contribute to platform engineering best practices, governance, and technical strategy.</li> <li>Lead incident response, reliability improvements, root cause analysis, and operational maturity initiatives.</li> <li>Improve platform security, scalability, resiliency, and deployment efficiency across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.</li> <li>Evaluate and introduce new technologies, tooling, and automation opportunities aligned with platform engineering goals.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Required Skills & Experience</strong></div> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineering, or related roles.</li> <li>Strong expertise in designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD and cloud-native platforms.</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with: <ul> <li>Jenkins</li> <li>Kargo / ArgoCD</li> <li>GitHub Enterprise</li> <li>Terraform / Terraform Enterprise</li> <li>Kubernetes & Helm</li> <li>Docker</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong experience with multi-cloud infrastructure: <ul> <li>AWS, Azure, and/or GCP</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong understanding of observability ecosystems including: <ul> <li>Grafana</li> <li>Loki</li> <li>Prometheus</li> <li>OpenTelemetry tooling</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong scripting/programming experience with Python, Kotlin, Bash, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with build and dependency tooling such as Gradle, Poetry, and UV.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, distributed systems, and platform reliability engineering.</li> <li>Experience driving platform modernization and developer enablement initiatives.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP) at enterprise scale.</li> <li>Experience with platform governance, security, secrets management, and compliance integration.</li> <li>Exposure to event-driven platform architectures and scalable distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience mentoring teams and influencing engineering standards across organizations.</li> <li>Knowledge of modern platform engineering trends, GitOps practices, and cloud-native ecosystems.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Technologies You’ll Work With</strong></div> <ul> <li>Jenkins, Kargo, ArgoCD</li> <li>GitHub Enterprise</li> <li>Terraform & Terraform Enterprise</li> <li>Docker, Kubernetes, Helm</li> <li>AWS, Azure, GCP</li> <li>Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry</li> <li>Python, Kotlin, Gradle</li> <li>UV, Poetry</li> <li>Linux & Networking</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  </p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong>  </p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not:  </p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  </li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  </li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  </p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our Candidate Privacy Notice.
