title: Customer Success Manager
description: Who are we? At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Why are we hiring for this role? Due to continued growth, the Customer Success team is expanding and we require a Customer Success Manager to join our high-performing team to onboard and enable our customers. The ideal candidate will be experienced in leading customer interactions, detail-oriented, articulate, and credible with the ability to listen effectively and provide clear advice. As a Customer Success Manager, you'll report to the Head of Customer Success, EMEA, and analyze the causes of your customer’s greatest pain points and work closely to mitigate them using UpGuard technology. You will solicit constant feedback from both customers and colleagues, helping improve UpGuard over time, and you’ll work with customers around the world, from early contact to successful deployment, gaining constant, and unique, insight into the world's most important industries and institutions. What will you accomplish? You will onboard and manage UpGuard customers to ensure they understand how best to use UpGuard effectively to meet their goals. You will provide resources to your customers, including success plans, and customer-specific training sessions. You will also organize regular check-in calls. You will engage your customers early and frequently, to help them get the most out of UpGuard from day one and continue to drive engagement. You will translate your customers’ requirements by understanding their risk management frameworks to offer a tailored solution on how best they can utilize UpGuard. You will monitor the health of your customers and intervene with proactive education when customers are not effectively using UpGuard to achieve the value they expected. Advocate for the customer; Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product, Sales, and Marketing) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities. What do we need from you? 5+ years' experience in customer success, and account management working with or for enterprise organizations. Self-starter with a proven track record of driving customer success and aligning complex customer solutions at the executive and department levels. Experience with supporting, building & maintaining customer relationships. Highly organized with the ability to update existing documentation and document new processes. Proven success in owning growth and revenue for a book of business including the end-to-end renewal process. An understanding of cyber risk management or risk management frameworks. Experience navigating large and complex organizations to multithread and uncover opportunities for expansion. High level of proficiency in the English language, both written and spoken. The ability to work cross-functionally with many internal groups and be a team player. Can translate complex ideas to a variety of audiences. Ability to work with multiple teams, stakeholders, and subsidiaries within an organization. High energy and a willingness to learn. Self-motivated, independent, and organized. What would give you an edge? Experience in Customer Success tools, such as ChurnZero or GainSight. Experience with a CRM, such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Understanding of technical cyber security compliance and certification activities such as NIST, PCI, and ISO27001. Understanding of Cyber Security best practices. Experience in project management. Basic/working knowledge of APIs. Experience navigating large enterprise relationships from implementation through value recognition and expansion. What’s in it for you? title: Senior Product Manager
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. About the Role Summary Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups. We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line. This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability. A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on. Success Metrics / KPIs Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window. Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter. Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release. Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release. Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding. What You'll Do Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy. Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write. Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release. Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release. Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet. Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content. Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization. Functional Competencies Required: 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end. Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface. Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team. Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter. Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually. Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is. Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations. Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material. Preferred / Nice to Have: Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it. Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform. Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers. Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security. Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls. Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction. Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Menlo Mindsets The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success. Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same. What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go. Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same. What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises. United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes. Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development. Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value. What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research. We’re here to stop that, by making sure that the right claims are reviewed for any policyholder or indemnity related concerns. What you’ll be doing Reviewing indemnity referrals flagged by our wider claims team, where it has been identified at the point of claim that customers have misrepresented their policy details, and deciding upon the appropriate course of action for the policy and claim Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers Who you are You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers You are tenacious and persistent; title: Technical Trainer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Client Education team Every hx customer's success depends on their teams knowing how to use our platform well - not just how to click through it, but how to build genuinely good pricing models with it. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from. The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace. We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land. What you'll be doing Deliver technical training sessions, live and online, to clients and partners - covering everything from platform fundamentals to how to build pricing models using hx's AI agents and product tooling. Build and maintain high-quality course content (online modules, video tutorials, workshop materials) that keeps pace with new product releases and evolving client needs. Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform. Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one. Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard. Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging. What you'll need to have done Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from. Studied Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or built equivalent hands-on comfort with programming languages (Python or similar) through experience. Worked hands-on with SaaS tools, APIs, or similar technical products, even without a formal software engineering background. Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure. Communicated confidently and clearly with clients or external stakeholders, adjusting technical depth to fit the audience in front of you. Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief. You're unlikely to thrive here if You'd rather follow a fixed curriculum than build and adapt training material as the product changes under you. You're not comfortable being hands-on with technical concepts and tooling, even at a foundational level. You prefer working in isolation rather than pulling in context from Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to get training right. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview Process Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off (30 minutes) Manager interview with Dom (60 minutes) Practical training assessment: build and present a short curriculum plan for a real hx feature, followed by discussion (60-90 minutes) Values interview (60 minutes) Meet the CEO We offer! Our commitment to Diversity hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <p>As the Senior Product Manager<strong>, </strong>you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.</p> <ul> <li>Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs</li> <li>Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences</li> <li>Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, strategic insights and actionable plans</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision</li> <li>Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels</li> <li>Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>. </p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. title: Campaign Manager
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. The Role We run multi-channel brand campaigns: social, content, video, out-of-home, events and road shows, often all at once. We've got plenty of ideas and a growing calendar. What we're missing is someone who owns delivery from the first brief to the final asset, across every channel. This is a hands-on generalist role. Campaign ideas can come from the wider team (or yourself!), but you'll make it happen: the plan, the timeline, the budget, the agency or freelancer, the channel mix, the logistics when a campaign goes offline, and sometimes even copy or campaign set up. You organise and you do. You’re the connect point between Brand & Credibility and other teams, internal and external. You'll work day to day with the Brand and Credibility team, our product marketers, and across tem's other teams as campaigns touch them. You will: Own campaigns from brief to delivery across owned and offline channels, on brand, on time, on budget. Plan and run events and support road shows. Find, brief and manage agencies and freelancers: creative, media, production, experiential. Keep multiple projects moving at once across teams that don't report to you. Embed AI workflows or tooling to maximize efficiency and effectiveness in our service Responsibilities Campaign delivery Build briefs, timelines and budget plans, then drive execution to completion. Keep deliverables aligned across channels and accurate, working with product marketing to check every claim. Spot and act on comms opportunities around key brand moments. Align the Brand and Credibility campaign calendar with the rest of the business needs Run a short post-campaign review each time so the next one is sharper. Events and offline Own roadshow support, customer events and out-of-home from planning through to the day itself, including the logistics. Travel to events roughly once a month (a day or two, UK). Manage merch and swag: design, ordering, distribution. Support in the branding needs around our bi-annual internal company-wide event, temfest Agencies and freelancers Source and manage external partners, own the brief and artwork through to delivery, and hold them to time and budget. Coordinate freelancer-led paid tests when we run them. You don't need to run paid yourself (but huge plus if you can). Requirements Must haves 2-4 years in a marketing, agency or creative production role where you delivered multi-channel campaigns or events end to end. You've managed budgets and kept projects on time and on spec, including at least one that got messy. You've sourced, briefed and managed external partners: agencies, freelancers, suppliers. Comfortable with ambiguity: you can take a one-line brief and turn it into a plan, then adjust when priorities shift. You use AI tools daily to plan, write, analyse faster, and empower others. Bonus points Agency background (account management, project management, creative ops, production). B2B or B2B tech experience, and a view on which B2B brands are doing it well and why. You've set up basic paid social or search campaigns yourself. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Customer Success Lead
description: 💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. That sounds cool - what does a Customer Success Lead have to do with it? Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs and is growing fast in secondary care. To keep up with how the NHS is organising itself, our Account Management team has just moved to a regional model, with leads for London, the South and the North. The goal is simple: join up what we’re learning across primary care, secondary care, acute, community and mental health, and make sure the best opportunities get surfaced across the whole of England, not just in one set of ICBs. We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead for the North. You’ll lead a team of Customer Success Managers across primary and secondary care and be the strategic, zoomed-out view of the region. Your team is close to the accounts. Your job is to spot the patterns across them, turn what they’re hearing into strategy, and help Accurx show up at a regional level. The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Lead Lead and grow a team of CSMs. You’ll start with three CSMs, each with their own region, customers and stage of the customer journey. You’ll coach them, unblock them and help them do the best work of their careers. Bring two very different care settings together. Primary care is about deepening trust we’ve built over years. Secondary care is about firsts: new services, longer implementations and goalposts that move. You’ll work out what connects them, what doesn’t, and where learnings from one can speed up the other. Turn insight into strategy. Your team will feed you what’s happening on the ground. You’ll spot trends, gaps and duplicated effort across the region and turn them into projects, goals and growth opportunities in products like Accurx Scribe and Total Triage. Own the commercial picture for your region. You’ll keep a close eye on churn, risk, renewals and upsell across your team’s accounts, and represent the region at our weekly business reviews with the exec team. Build the playbook with your fellow leads. The regional model is brand new. Alongside the leads for London and the South, you’ll shape how we work, what best practice looks like and how we scale it. Be the link across the business. You’ll work closely with implementation, transformation, support and business development, making sure the voice of our customers shapes where Accurx goes next. You should apply if... You’ve led customer-facing teams. You have a few years of people management in customer success or account management, and you love helping others grow. You’ve built things from the ground up. You’ve been on a startup to scale-up journey, worn a lot of hats, and taken customers from never having heard of you to being your biggest advocates. You care about depth, not volume. You’ve looked after long-standing, strategic relationships rather than a high-volume queue, and you know that trust is what makes customers stick. You can zoom out. You don’t need to be in the weeds of every account. You’re great at spotting patterns, asking the right questions and knowing where your team needs you most. You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You’re happy to try something, get it wrong, learn and go again. Process is something you create, not something you wait for. You’re a big collaborator. You’re an incredible communicator and listener, and you know the best outcomes come from working across teams. You’re curious about the NHS. Healthcare experience is welcome but not essential. What matters is empathy for the pressure the NHS is under and the patience to build trust in a complex system. What’s in it for me? You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity. £70,000 - £90,000 salary + share options up to £30,000 Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am-4pm Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat! Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? title: GRC Security Specialist
description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. The role We are formalising our security assurance function. We have technical controls and the engineering culture; what we need now is the governance layer that proves it - to our auditors, to our funders, and to our regulator. You will be the delivery engine behind that. You will own the recurring assurance cycle end to end, run our third-party security programme, and be the person who turns evidence into something a due diligence team or a certification auditor can be satisfied by. You will be responsible for building controls, gathering evidence, and challenging suppliers. What you will own: 1. Third-party security assurance - Run security due diligence on new suppliers, maintain initial questionnaire to risk sign-off, working with Procurement and Legal on security and data protection schedules. - Maintain a supplier tiering model based on criticality and run the periodic re-assessment cycle for tiered suppliers: certification expiry, subprocessor changes, breach notifications, SLA performance. - Maintain the supplier and outsourcing registers, including preparation for the FCA's material third party register under PS26/2 (rules in force 18 March 2027). - Track concentration risk and exit plans for critical suppliers. 2. Inbound due diligence and customer assurance - Own our response to security due diligence from funders, banking partners, institutional investors, commercial partners and prospects. - Build and maintain a reusable trust pack: answer library, security whitepaper, current certifications, pen test attestations, standard questionnaire pre-fills (SIG, CAIQ). - Turn a 40-hour bespoke questionnaire response into a 4-hour one. 3. The assurance calendar - Maintain the annual calendar of security activities and make sure each one happens, produces evidence, and closes its actions: penetration tests, access reviews, disaster recovery tests, tabletop exercises, policy reviews, supplier re-assessments, awareness training. - Coordinate external penetration tests: scoping, vendor selection, scheduling, findings triage, remediation tracking, retest. - Facilitate tabletop exercises, including scenario design and post-exercise action tracking. 4. Risk and control administration - Maintain the information security risk register: run the assessment cycle, record treatment plans with named owners and dates, chase closure. - Administer the policy exception and risk acceptance process, ensuring every exception is owned, time-bound and reviewed on expiry. - Perform first-line control testing: sample-test where key controls operate as designed and retain the evidence. - Produce security MI for the Head of Security to take to ExCo and the Risk Committee. 5. Vulnerability and findings management - Consolidate findings across sources — EDR, cloud security posture, SAST/DAST/SCA, secrets scanning, penetration tests — into a single view with agreed severity definitions and remediation SLAs. - Triage, route and chase remediation with engineering teams; escalate ageing findings. - Own the reporting on remediation performance. 6. Security awareness - Run the awareness programme: induction, annual refresher, phishing simulation, role-based training for engineers, completion tracking. - Coordinate pre-employment screening with People. What you will contribute to: - The ISO 27001 ISMS , which we are building towards certification. You will draft and maintain control documentation, populate the Statement of Applicability, gather evidence, coordinate the internal audit programme and be a primary point of contact for our external auditor. The Head of Security owns the framework, scope, and risk appetite. - Policies and standards: you will draft, review and shepherd policies through approval, and track the review cycle. - Incident response: you will maintain the IR plan and playbooks, facilitate post-incident reviews, track remediation actions, and support regulatory notification (ICO personal data breach reporting within 72 hours; FCA notification under Principle 11 / SUP 15.3). - Business continuity and DR: you will maintain the documentation and the testing evidence. - Secure development: you will help embed security requirements into the SDLC and support threat modelling sessions. - Data protection: you will support RoPA maintenance, DPIA completion and DSAR handling alongside Legal. What success looks like: First 90 days: you know our supplier estate and have tiered it; the assurance calendar for the next 12 months is published and owned; inbound due diligence requests come to you and go out without the Head of Security rewriting them. Six months: the trust pack exists and is being used; the risk register is live with owned treatment plans; ISO 27001 evidence collection is systematic rather than a scramble; the exception register exists. Twelve months: supplier re-assessment runs on a cadence without prompting; the material third party register is ready ahead of the March 2027 deadline; MI to the Risk Committee is trusted. Essential experience: - Three or more years in an information security assurance, GRC or security compliance role, at least some of it in a regulated financial services environment or another environment with real external audit pressure. - Hands-on experience of ISO 27001, whether operating an ISMS or taking one through certification. - Demonstrable experience running third-party or vendor security assessments, and of responding to inbound security due diligence. - Comfortable reading technical findings — an EDR vulnerability report, a penetration test finding, a cloud misconfiguration — and forming your own view on severity and real-world exploitability rather than passing the vendor's rating through unchanged. - Clear, concise written English. Much of this role is writing things that external parties will judge us on. - The confidence to chase a busy engineer, challenge a supplier's assertion, and tell us when an answer is not good enough. Desirable: - Experience of a cloud-native environment, ideally AWS. - Experience of scaling a control framework as an organisation grows. - Familiarity with UK operational resilience expectations (SYSC 15A) and outsourcing requirements (SYSC 8). - Certifications such as CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CRISC or CCSP. We care more about what you have done than what you hold. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. title: UK New Business Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>About WPP Production</strong></p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://wpp.com/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$" data-outlook-id="6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd">WPP.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>A Hybrid working model</strong></p> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p class="xmsonormal"><em>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</em></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>What does an UK- New Business Director do at WPP Production?</strong> <br><strong> </strong> </p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, <strong>defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our UK growth function</strong>.</p> <p>You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority new business opportunities, <strong>designing integrated solutions and clear go-to-market propositions.  </strong>You will ensure that every response (whether formal RFP or informal approach) is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the <strong>quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all UK pitches</strong>, setting the standard for how we articulate our value.</p> <p>Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in <strong>driving integration across Media, Creative and Production</strong>, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.</p> <p>Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — <strong>defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally</strong>. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role with visibility across the whole UK business, suited to someone who thrives in the fast-paced world of new business, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key areas of responsibility:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning</li> <li>Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value</li> <li>Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition</li> <li>Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market</li> <li>Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus</li> <li>Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities</li> <li>Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next</li> <li>Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions</li> <li>Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach</li> <li>Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency</li> <li>Act as a “pitch doctor”, stepping into critical integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production</li> <li>Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches</li> <li>Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency</li> <li>Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations</li> <li>Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong>What good looks like:</p> <ul> multi-disciplinary pitches</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions</li> <li>Able to use and apply AI tools to the new business process</li> <li>Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines</li> <li>Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level</li> <li>Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously</li> <li>Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative and production</li> <li>Able to influence and align senior title: HR Technology Director
description: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Director, HR Technology & Solutions Delivery is a senior technology leadership role responsible for the strategy, design, delivery, operation and evolution of Inizio's global HR technology ecosystem.</p> <p>In the near term, the role has significant accountability for Workday, leading day-to-day IT operations, functional solution design, enhancements, continuous improvement and strategic HR technology projects.</p> <p>Over time, the role will evolve HR Technology towards a stronger platform engineering and architecture-led model, establishing the technical strategy, engineering practices, integration architecture, governance, security and operational capabilities required to support Inizio at scale.</p> <p>This requires a leader who can operate across both the functional and technical dimensions of Workday – translating HR requirements into effective solutions while bringing the technical depth and engineering mindset to shape the future HR technology landscape.</p> <p>You will have end-to-end IT accountability for Workday and the wider HR technology ecosystem. The Workday IT Operations team will report directly to this role, which reports to the Deputy Chief Information Officer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Workday Platform, Operations & Functional Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide end-to-end IT ownership of Workday, covering functional design, configuration, operations, support, enhancements and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner with HR People Services and Centres of Excellence to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Workday solutions aligned with global standards.</li> ensuring effective management of incidents, requests, defects, changes, enhancements and releases.</li> <li>Establish effective service levels, operational KPIs, demand and backlog management, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation and operational controls.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement, automation and proactive platform management to improve user experience, reliability and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Act as the senior escalation and decision point for significant Workday functional, technical and operational matters.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>HR Technology Project & Solutions Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>HR Technology Strategy: Own end-to-end technology delivery of significant Workday and wider HR technology initiatives, from requirements and solution dependencies, resources, risks, quality and budget.</li> <li>Hold systems integrators and delivery partners accountable for delivery, solution quality, knowledge transfer and sustainable support.</li> technology is scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable and aligned with Inizio's wider enterprise technology strategy.</li> <li>Manage technical debt and identify opportunities to simplify and modernise the HR technology estate.</li> <li>Develop internal technical capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners for core platform knowledge.</li> </ul> <p> </p> reliable connectivity between Workday, HR applications, enterprise platforms, identity services, data platforms and external providers.</li> <li>Establish appropriate integration patterns, APIs, middleware and data standards, reducing unnecessary point-to-point connectivity.</li> <li>Ensure appropriate controls across cyber security, data privacy, identity and access management, privileged access, segregation of duties and change management.</li> <li>Embed security, risk and compliance requirements into solution design and delivery and maintain appropriate controls and audit evidence.</li> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data and Integration teams to ensure HR technology aligns with enterprise standards.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Vendor, Commercial & HR Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the senior IT partner to HR leadership, translating HR strategy and operational priorities into an actionable technology roadmap.</li> <li>Work with HR People Services and Centres of Excellence to shape solutions and prioritise BAU enhancements, projects and strategic investments.</li> <li>Provide guidance on Workday capabilities and wider opportunities including automation, AI and emerging HR technologies.</li> <li>Manage strategic relationships with Workday, technology vendors, systems integrators and specialist partners.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable for technical capability, solution quality, service, delivery and commercial outcomes and provide technology leadership for vendor selection and investment decisions.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Leadership & Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology team with the right balance of Workday functional, technical, integration, engineering and operational capabilities.</li> <li>Develop the technical maturity of the function through coaching, standards and strong engineering practices.</li> <li>Foster collaboration across HR, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data, Integration and wider IT.</li> <li>Establish a culture of ownership, customer focus, engineering quality, accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Act as a visible and credible senior technology leader across the organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <p>You are an experienced HR can lead functional solution design and delivery, while being equally comfortable discussing integrations, architecture, security, engineering and enterprise technology.</p> <p>You will bring:</p> description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment. </p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble.</p></div><p>Team: Search & Social (Commerce Division), THG Ingenuity</p> <p><strong>Introduction</strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a leading ecommerce and technology business, powering some of the world's most recognised brands. Our Search & Social team sits within the wider Commerce division, operating at the intersection of ecommerce, marketing, and commercial strategy. Alongside our Content and Paid Media teams, we connect brands with customers through world-class organic and paid search strategies.</p> <p>We're looking for an ambitious, detail-oriented graduate to join our team and help shape the future of search. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a passion for SEO to build a career at the forefront of digital marketing, working on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-driven search within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p> <p>Success in this role requires a deep curiosity for search engine algorithms, strong analytical skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to build positive relationships with internal teams (like eCommerce, Paid Media, and project management) and external brand clients.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an SEO & GEO Executive, you will support the planning, execution, optimisation, and reporting of organic search campaigns across multiple brands. You will work to grow organic visibility, traffic, and revenue, ensuring our clients dominate the search engine results pages (SERPs).</p> <p>You'll work in close partnership with our Paid Media team to ensure our organic and paid search strategies are fully aligned. You'll also collaborate daily with the eCommerce teams who are trading the sites, project teams managing site onboards, and external brand partners, ensuring SEO is a core pillar of our commercial success.</p> <p>This role combines technical SEO, content strategy, performance analysis, and stakeholder management, providing a well-rounded foundation in the future of search.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the end-to-end delivery of SEO strategies for multiple brands.</li> <li>Conduct keyword research, content gap analysis, and SERP analysis to identify new growth opportunities.</li> <li>Perform technical SEO audits to identify and fix issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexation.</li> <li>Collaborate with content teams to ensure on-page content is optimised for both users and search engines.</li> <li>Analyse and report on organic performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and industry-standard search analytics platforms.</li> <li>Work closely with the Paid Media team to share search query insights, coordinate keyword targeting, and develop a unified search strategy.</li> <li>Support project teams with SEO requirements for site migrations and new client onboards.</li> <li>Stay informed on algorithm updates, competitor activity, and emerging trends, particularly in AI-driven search and GEO.</li> <li>Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (eCommerce, Content, Paid Media) and external brand clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who is:</p> <ul> <li>A recent graduate with a primary passion for SEO and organic search, and a keen interest in related fields like Paid Media, eCommerce, client services, or digital marketing.</li> <li>Highly organised with strong time management and prioritisation skills.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with exceptionally high standards of accuracy and quality.</li> <li>Commercially aware and interested in how SEO drives business performance.</li> <li>A strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Professional, collaborative and able to build positive stakeholder relationships with both internal teams and external clients.</li> <li>Proactive, accountable and comfortable taking ownership of their work.</li> <li>Curious, adaptable and eager to learn about the future of search.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></p> <p>Essential</p> <ul> <li>A foundational understanding of SEO principles (technical, on-page, and off-page).</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail.</li> <li>Strong written communication skills, including grammar and spelling.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.</li> <li>A genuine appetite and eagerness to learn and develop.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some hands-on experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics (GA4).</li> <li>Familiarity with web crawling or search analytics platforms.</li> <li>Understanding of the relationship between SEO and other digital marketing channels like Paid Media, Content, and eCommerce.</li> <li>Experience working in a fast-paced, commercial environment.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Fullstack Engineer, Consumer Order Experience
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Why Deliveroo? We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers. Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact on your own development, on Deliveroo as we scale, and on the marketplace and communities we serve. Consumer Ordering Experience owns the core purchase journey: the store page, item page, basket, and checkout flow, across both app and web. It's a global team — the surfaces we build support all of our brands: Deliveroo, Wolt, and Doordash. You'd be the team's first dedicated web/full-stack engineer, helping us build out our web experience from the ground up. What You'll Do Own and evolve the store, item, basket, and checkout experiences on web, working primarily in React and TypeScript Contribute to backend services written in Golang — deep Go experience isn't a hard requirement, but you should be comfortable picking up a new statically typed backend language Improve code structure, shape architecture, and review code across the team Partner closely with your Product Manager and fellow engineers to scope and ship changes to the ordering funnel Take part in the hiring process and support the growth of your teammates as the team scales What We're Looking For Must haves: Strong full-stack experience — comfortable working across web frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go, or similar) to unblock delivery end-to-end Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters) Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief PRD through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents Nice to haves: Experience coordinating engineers across multiple platforms (iOS/Android/Web/BE) on a single initiative Active use of AI-assisted coding workflows, and interest in building reusable tooling/skills for the team We're looking for someone London-based who can work from our office 2–3 days a week alongside the rest of the team. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.
