title: Legal Counsel
description: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the role. We are looking for a dynamic Legal Counsel, with circa 1-4 years PQE, to play a vital role in providing legal support and advice to our organisation as we continue to expand our operations in the UK and internationally. You will work closely with other members of our Legal team and teams across the business to advise on a broad range of legal matters, including arrangements with our commercial partners, corporate transactions and governance initiatives, and help ensure that we continue to comply with relevant laws and regulations in the UK and across international markets. You’ll have an interest in a varied workload, with strong drafting and negotiating skills, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to balance legal risk with business priorities. You’ll be proactive and hands-on in your approach, happy to get stuck into a broad range of legal work, able to work independently while knowing when to escalate, and capable of building trust with business teams. In addition, you’ll have a focus on developing and maintaining the legal processes, policies and precedents that underpin our business. This is a fantastic opportunity if you enjoy operating in a fast-paced, growing business where priorities can change quickly, and are looking to take real ownership for what you do. Day to day responsibilities. Work with our business teams to draft, review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, and other legal documents with third parties, including our key suppliers and partners, whilst maintaining the processes that underpin them. Support with corporate matters including acquisitions, capital raising, group structure and integration projects, international expansion, debt arrangements and employee share schemes. Support with governance and investor relations initiatives, including the preparation of board and committee papers and resolutions, updating our cap table and maintaining internal trackers. Assist in resolving legal disputes, including working with external counsel when necessary. Be a trusted legal advisor to our commercial teams to help establish, maintain, and expand business relationships whilst providing input into new products and initiatives. Identify legal risks and propose strategies to mitigate them. Support the consideration and implementation of new legal tech tools and the development and maintenance of processes, policies and procedures and standard legal documents. Conduct legal research on various topics, including emerging legal issues which may impact our business, and provide recommendations to the legal team and senior management. Develop and deliver legal training programmes to internal teams to ensure awareness of legal and regulatory requirements. Key requirements: Ideally, 1-4 years PQE. A current practising certificate (qualified in England and Wales is preferred). Meaningful and relevant experience either from private practice or in-house. Experience gained in a fintech or another fast-paced technology business or internationally would be a bonus, but otherwise you should be able to demonstrate enthusiasm for gaining that experience. Solid drafting, reviewing, negotiation and problem-solving skills. Solutions-focused attitude, with a commercial-minded risk appetite. Excellent attention to detail. Strong stakeholder and time-management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Electrical Engineer II (Integrations)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing. 🚀 What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers. Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team. Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows. Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets. Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process. Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution. Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation. Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control. Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation. Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support. Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus. CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion. Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team. Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration. A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time. Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote. ⭐️ Bonus points Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in. Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures. Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness). Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏡 Where you'll fit in: KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants. The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant. What is Optimisation in Flex? The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns. The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies. The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute. Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine. 🚀 What you’ll own: The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably. This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth. Managing the leads. title: Senior Account Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Account Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor and a cornerstone of our commercial team. You'll own an above-average revenue target and be expected to consistently deliver, and exceed, it. Operating with a high degree of autonomy; you'll manage complex, high-value deals end-to-end, drive forecast accuracy, and actively shape how we go to market. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic influence: you'll be as comfortable building a Looker report as you are leading a high-stakes negotiation, and as effective with Finance and Product as you are in front of a customer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow a portfolio of key accounts, consistently exceeding revenue targets and carrying above-average quota.</li> <li>Maintain accurate pipeline and revenue forecasts, surfacing risks proactively and identifying in-quarter opportunities to accelerate attainment.</li> <li>Lead complex, high-value negotiations; adapting style to different stakeholders and closing with minimal concessions.</li> <li>Build and tailor compelling value propositions, running multi-channel outreach to fill and advance pipeline efficiently.</li> <li>Manage multiple concurrent work-streams with clear ownership, balancing scope, time, and quality with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to deliver solutions and influence roadmap priorities based on customer feedback.</li> <li>Analyse multi-dimensional data in Looker, AI and Google Sheets to surface actionable insights and build compelling, decision-driving narratives.</li> <li>Coach junior team members and contribute to a culture of proactive, well-received feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in digital advertising, account management, or consultative sales; preferably within mobile or programmatic ad-tech.</li> <li>Strong forecasting discipline and pipeline management skills, with experience running high-value deals from prospecting through close.</li> <li>Skilled negotiator who adapts approach intuitively and is comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</li> <li>Proficient in Looker, AI and Google Sheets, with the ability to analyse complex data sets and build clear, impactful visualisations independently.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional collaborator, with experience engaging Product, Finance, and Marketing beyond immediate deal needs.</li> <li>High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and the ability to give and receive feedback constructively.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree; advanced degree a plus.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 10% for client meetings and industry events.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Travel Expectations:</strong></p> <p>We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.</p> <hr> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.</p> <p> </p> <p>Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p><strong>Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. title: Director/Senior Director, Molecular Discovery
description: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>The Director, Molecular Discovery is responsible for ensuring our autonomous science platform reliably and repeatedly delivers validated small-molecule drug candidates against designated targets at increasing speed. The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.</p> <p>This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.</li> <li>Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.</li> <li>Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.</li> <li>Collaborate daily with AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform's predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.</li> <li>Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute. Define and enforce the quality standards, assay cascades, and decision criteria that govern how compounds progress through the pipeline.</li> <li>Facilitate relationships with CROs and external partners for specialized studies (e.g., in vivo pharmacology, safety pharmacology, DMPK) that sit outside the automated platform.</li> <li>Provide drug discovery expertise to Lila's product team for commercial partnerships, translating platform capabilities into credible value propositions for pharma and biotech collaborators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ph.D. in medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, or a closely related discipline.</li> <li>12+ years of experience in small molecule drug discovery from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side with at least 5 years in a senior role closely involved in advancing compounds from hit-to-lead through candidate selection.</li> <li>Demonstrated involvement in programs that delivered clinical candidates, with enough proximity to compound progression decisions to own them whether from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side.</li> <li>Deep fluency in medicinal chemistry principles, you may not have practiced bench medchem, but you understand SAR, synthetic tractability, and the multiparameter tradeoffs at the core of lead optimization (potency, selectivity, ADMET, PK, safety) well enough to guide them or define systematic decision frameworks for them.</li> <li>Operational mindset, experience running discovery programs with clear metrics, milestones, and accountability structures, and a comfort level with managing throughput and efficiency alongside scientific quality.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ADMET, DMPK, and the data packages required to advance a candidate to IND-enabling studies.</li> <li>Fluency with AI/ML-driven molecular design approaches (generative chemistry, molecular property prediction, free energy methods, active learning) and the practical judgment to know when computational output is actionable and when it needs experimental validation. You don’t need to build models, but you must be a credible, hands-on collaborator with the scientists who do.</li> <li>Effective communicator who can translate complex scientific and operational status into clear updates for leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience with automated, high-throughput, or closed-loop discovery environments (e.g., self-driving labs, robotic synthesis and screening platforms), you've seen what it takes to make these systems produce real drug discovery output, not just proof-of-concept demos.</li> <li>Experience applying computational chemistry or cheminformatics in a hands-on capacity, not just consuming model outputs, but contributing to how molecular design hypotheses are generated, scored, and prioritized.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling a discovery operation from early stage, standing up assay cascades, workflows, team structures, and vendor relationships without inheriting a mature infrastructure.</li> <li>Background across multiple therapeutic areas, giving you breadth in target biology and the flexibility to work across a diverse portfolio.</li> <li>Process-oriented thinking: you instinctively look for ways to measure, standardize, and improve how work gets done, without letting process become bureaucracy.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.</p> <p><strong>U.S. Benefits.</strong> Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.</p> <p><strong>International Benefits.</strong> Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.</p></div><div class="title">Expected Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$202,400</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$323,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About LILA</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.</p> <p>LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.</p> <p>Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>We’re All In</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.</p> <p>Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our <a href="https://www.lila.ai/candidate-privacy-policy-notice">Candidate Privacy Policy</a>.</p> <p><strong>A Note to Agencies</strong></p> <p><em>Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Talent Partner EMEA *Contractor*
description: <p><strong><u>About the role:</u></strong></p> <p>With our continued international growth, we are looking for a <strong>Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (EMEA) contractor</strong> to serve as a strategic partner to our Sales and Go-To-Market (GTM) leadership. Reporting to the Director of International Talent, you will be responsible for scaling our regional headcount while building deep, consultative relationships with stakeholders across EMEA.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role designed for a recruiter who excels at execution but also thrives in the programmatic space—leading initiatives in process optimisation, and employer branding to ensure an exceptional candidate experience.</p> <p><strong><u>Where You Can Make an Impact</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Full-Cycle Execution: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from initial sourcing to closing, delivering a "white-glove" experience for both candidates and hiring managers.</li> <li>Strategic Partnership: Act as a key advisor to heads of sales and broader leadership, providing data-driven insights to guide hiring decisions.</li> <li>Recruitment Strategy: Own the hiring lifecycle from concept to execution, building scalable solutions that meet the demands of a high-growth tech environment.</li> <li>Passive Talent Attraction: Utilize creative sourcing techniques to identify and "hook" top-tier passive talent within the competitive GTM and Sales landscape.</li> <li>Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of market trends to provide executive guidance and mentor the wider recruiting team on best practices.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Projects: Lead high-visibility initiatives outside of standard hiring, including regional talent branding (webinars, collateral), diversity programs, and stakeholder training.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>The GTM Expert: You have a minimum 5+ years of in-house recruitment experience specifically within dynamic GTM/Sales environments within hyper growth Saas / Tech. (8+ years total experience preferred) + recruitment agency exp before that.</li> <li>A Master Communicator: You possess the "pitching" skills required to articulate complex value propositions and influence high-level stakeholders.</li> <li>Data-Driven & Detailed: You have a strong attention to detail and the ability to analyze recruiting metrics to optimize team effectiveness.</li> <li>Resilient & High-Velocity: You operate with natural grit, tenacity, and a sense of urgency, moving quickly without sacrificing integrity.</li> <li>Adaptable: You are comfortable managing a diverse req-load ranging from entry-level to executive leadership across multiple European territories.</li> <li>Education: A BA/BS degree is preferred, but we value experience and a proven track record of success above all else.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Language Skills: Fluency in French is a strong advantage although not a must have, as you will play a pivotal role in supporting our SEUR region (French, Italy & Spain) among others.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. </p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> | <a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled</h2> <p>Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.</p> <p>Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. </p> <p>Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at ----- if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. title: DACH Enterprise Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>Faire’s quality, depth, and breadth of brands is its strongest value to retailers. Our Brand Partnerships team is at the forefront of Faire’s success, ensuring that the best and most relevant brands join and thrive on our platform.</p> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive (ENT+, L4), you will be a trusted advisor to the largest, most influential brands in the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) and byond, helping them unlock wholesale growth on Faire and driving significant, durable GMV at scale.</p> <p>This role is a blend of strategic thinking and enterprise sales execution. You will own a concentrated portfolio of Faire’s highest-value DACH brands, running complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles from first outreach through C-suite negotiation. You bring a strong commercial mindset, comfortable operating at the most senior levels of an organisation, and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform. German and English bilingual fluency is mandatory: you will lead the full sales cycle natively in German, with no reliance on translation or a local partner to close.</p> <p>We are looking for a stellar performer: someone who has finished top 3 in their org, qualified for President’s Club or All-Stars, and is hungry to do it again in a market that is genuinely early and genuinely exciting.</p> <p><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have been top of the leaderboard before and you want to do it in the German-speaking market’s largest, most valuable brands, where your book becomes the enterprise playbook others inherit</li> <li>You are energised by fast-moving, ambiguous environments and see AI as a genuine force multiplier</li> <li>You want to sell something that actually matters: levelling the playing field for independent retailers against e-commerce and big-box giants is a mission you can get behind</li> <li>You want to work alongside a tight-knit team of high performers who share wins loudly, debug losses together, and hold themselves to a standard most sales teams only talk about</li> <li>You are curious by default: you dig until you understand, and you bring that intellectual rigour to every deal, especially the complex, multi-threaded ones that define enterprise DACH</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll do </strong></p> <p><strong>Identify and win the right opportunities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a concentrated, high-value book of ENT+ brands across DACH with the goal of maximising the incremental GMV that these flagship brands bring to the Faire platform</li> <li>Set your own sub-targets, hold yourself accountable, and know exactly what levers to pull when performance is under pressure, across fewer, larger, longer-cycle deals rather than a high-volume motion</li> <li>Use business data, category insights, AI-powered tooling, and your own DACH market knowledge to build a pipeline that is both strategically targeted and high quality</li> <li>Support new enterprise brands through their first quarter on Faire, ensuring they understand the platform and are set up to receive orders and grow</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead a best-in-class enterprise sales cycle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead every customer interaction with a personalised, insight-led approach: understanding each brand’s unique business and shaping Faire’s value proposition to their specific problems, delivered natively in German where needed</li> <li>Navigate multi-threaded, multi-quarter deals with confidence: from C-suite and board-level vision conversations to operational onboarding with sales, marketing, legal, and finance teams</li> <li>Develop tailored onboarding plans that balance near-term activation with long-term platform success at enterprise scale</li> <li>Make independent, well-reasoned decisions on when to advance a deal and when to pass, and own the outcome either way</li> <li>Stay resilient and input-focused when performance is challenging; model the standard for the team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Be the expert on the DACH market</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be solution-oriented to common objections and DACH-specific blockers, including local business norms, procurement processes, and regulatory considerations. Size the opportunity, identify what’s needed, and act on it with product and leadership</li> <li>Understand how competitors and industry players operate in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland and articulate Faire’s key differentiators with precision, in German and English</li> <li>Research trends, industry events, and key account signals across DACH, and bring that intelligence back to sharpen team strategy</li> </ul> <p><strong>Represent Faire across the wholesale industry</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive Faire’s value props and messaging across the full sales surface: outreach, nurture, DACH trade shows and events, and in-person brand visits</li> <li>Identify and pursue new enterprise business opportunities that drive incremental revenue for the platform</li> <li>Develop German-language content and host webinars to engage leads in your verticals and share onboarding best practices</li> <li>Collaborate with marketing to shape top-of-funnel messaging across paid, web, and nurture channels for the DACH market</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Must haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>German and English business-fluent, bilingual: mandatory. You will run the full sales cycle, including C-suite/board-level negotiation, natively in German</li> <li>Proven track record of exceeding quota at enterprise/strategic level: top 3 in your org, President’s Club / All-Stars qualifier</li> <li>Enterprise deal experience: comfortable running fewer, larger, multi-stakeholder deals with longer sales cycles, without losing rigor or urgency</li> <li>Sharp executive presence: comfortable operating at C-suite and board level</li> <li>AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to prospect, prep, and accelerate, not as a talking point but as a genuine lever</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity: you ask better questions, dig deeper, and find the unlock others miss</li> <li>Mission alignment: you believe in independent retail and can articulate why Faire matters</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>Existing network or relationships among large DACH brands</li> <li>Additional European language skills</li> <li>Background in wholesale, retail, or brand partnerships at enterprise scale</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Clay, or AI sales tooling</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li>Faire is being built for entrepreneurs, by entrepreneurs. We believe entrepreneurship is a calling and our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to chase their dreams. Every member of our team is an owner of the business and taking part in the founding process.We are entrepreneurs: </li> <li>We are leveraging the power of product innovation and machine learning to connect brands and boutiques from all over the world, building a growing community of more than 800,000 small business owners.We are using technology and data to level the playing field: </li> <li>Everything we do is ultimately in the service of helping our customers grow their business because our goal is to grow the pie, not steal a piece from it. Running a small business is hard work, but using Faire makes it easy.We build products our customers love: </li> <li>Inquisitive by default, we explore every possibility, test every assumption, and develop creative solutions to the challenges at hand. We lead with curiosity and data in our decision making, and reason from a first-principles mentality.We are curious and resourceful: </li> <li>Sequoia-backed, growing at 45%+ YoY goalbally, and building out our European presence at exactly the right moment, before the category is won. The DACH enterprise book you build today becomes the foundation everyone else inherits tomorrow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range</strong></p> <p>London, UK: the OTE pay range for this role is £<span data-sheets-root="1">108,000</span> to £<span data-sheets-root="1">148,500</span> per year. </p> <p>This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. <br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportu

title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
description:
<p>At Hudson River Trading (HRT) the Applied AI team’s mission is to increase the speed and quality of work across the firm’s most consequential workflows. We build AI systems that help researchers and developers iterate faster, automate increasingly complex work, and enable autonomous exploration at a scale that would not otherwise be possible.</p> <p>We apply frontier models and agentic systems to how quantitative research, software development, and other critical work at HRT gets done. We combine cutting-edge commercial and open-source models and tools with infrastructure, research, and systems of our own.</p> <p>Our work spans the full stack required to make this successful: AI infrastructure, research engineering, post-training and reinforcement learning, agent evaluation, security and alignment, and deployment into real workflows.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building scalable infrastructure for training, evaluating, and operating language models and AI agents</li> <li>Developing research environments, evaluation systems, and experimentation platforms that allow us to measure and improve agent performance</li> <li>Improving model and agent capabilities through post-training, reinforcement learning, prompting, tool design, and workflow optimization</li> <li>Designing sandboxing, policy enforcement, monitoring, and other safeguards for increasingly capable autonomous systems</li> <li>Partnering with teams across HRT to identify work AI can newly perform, develop effective solutions, and turn successful experiments into durable systems</li> <li>Evaluating new models, techniques, and products, and making informed decisions about when to build, buy, or adapt them</li> <li>Sharing technical knowledge and establishing effective practices for building and working with AI across HRT</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are an excellent engineer who can turn ambiguous problems into working systems</li> <li>You learn unfamiliar technical and business domains quickly and enjoy moving between them</li> <li>You care about advancing what AI systems can reliably accomplish</li> <li>You use rigorous measurement and experiment design to guide decisions</li> <li>You are comfortable operating across research and production engineering</li> <li>You communicate clearly and collaborate well with people from different technical backgrounds</li> <li>You are curious about the capabilities, limitations, and risks of increasingly autonomous systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience required</li> <li>Strong Python proficiency required</li> <li>Excellent software design, debugging, and problem-solving skills required</li> <li>Experience building and operating substantial software systems required</li> <li>Demonstrated engagement with modern AI systems, tools, or research required</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Machine learning research or engineering, including post-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or alignment</li> <li>AI-agent architecture, evaluation, or tool-use environments</li> <li>Distributed systems, model engineering: working closely with users to discover, build, and operationalize new capabilities</li> <li>Linux, systems performance, networking, C++, or TypeScript</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base title: Account Executive - Majors
description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 ClickUp is hiring a Majors Account Executive to grow and expand our footprint across larger EMEA customers. This role is built for a seller who can take strong product adoption, identify real whitespace, and turn it into broader, multi-team commercial growth. This is an especially important hire now because ClickUp’s international business already matters materially, and larger customers increasingly want to consolidate scattered tools, improve execution clarity, and understand how AI can create leverage across teams. We need someone who can run strong discovery, build a credible business case, and guide more complex stakeholder groups from interest to expansion. Mission Own and grow expansion revenue across major EMEA accounts by identifying whitespace, building business cases, and positioning ClickUp as the platform that helps larger teams work with more clarity, speed, and operational leverage. Key outcomes and responsibilities Own expansion opportunities across major accounts in your region, with a core focus on larger organisations in the roughly 1,000–2,500 employee range. Consistently exceed pipeline and sales targets by converting account signals, free trials, marketing-qualified leads, demo requests, and product adoption into qualified commercial opportunities. Run structured discovery that uncovers workflow pain, stakeholder priorities, buying friction, and the business case for broader ClickUp adoption. Deliver compelling presentations and demos that connect ClickUp’s platform value to customer priorities, cross-functional workflows, and executive-level outcomes. Build and manage multithreaded deal plans across end users, managers, executives, procurement, and other decision-makers. Partner closely with Growth, Marketing, and adjacent GTM teams to improve lead quality, regional account coverage, and conversion. Maintain strong process discipline across forecasting, pipeline inspection, next steps, CRM hygiene, and follow-through. Identify recurring patterns across segments, objections, and account behavior to help sharpen the majors expansion motion in EMEA. Support more formal buying motions when needed, including RFIs / RFQs and procurement-heavy evaluations. Required qualifications Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS sales with clear ownership of full-cycle deals, account growth, or expansion motions. Track record of exceeding quota and managing a disciplined pipeline in commercial, strategic, or larger-account environments. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort communicating with both practitioners and executive stakeholders. Clear consultative selling instincts, with the ability to connect customer pain to value, urgency, and practical next steps. Strong process rigor and attention to detail across forecasting, deal planning, and follow-through. Experience completing or leading RFIs / RFQs, or operating in deals with more structured evaluation processes. Ability to work in our Dublin / London office 2-3 days per week. Preferred qualifications Experience selling workflow, collaboration, productivity, CRM, CX, or adjacent horizontal SaaS platforms. Experience in an expansion-heavy, cross-sell, or land-and-expand motion rather than a purely transactional new-logo model. Experience navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups in larger customer environments. Familiarity with EMEA selling dynamics, regional complexity, or distributed territory ownership. Comfort selling a broader platform and AI productivity story instead of relying on feature-by-feature comparisons. #LI-SO1 #LI-Hybrid Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. title: Robotics Engineer
description: About Augur Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design. Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots. Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence. We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to join our growing technical team in London and take ownership of the integration of a new counter-UAS initiative. This role sits at the intersection of robotics, machine learning and systems engineering, and you'll own the integration across all three. You'll prove out the concept, build the prototype, and take it into trials, working closely with product partners and other stakeholders along the way. The role is highly interdisciplinary, so we're less concerned with ticking every box than with finding someone motivated, curious, and willing to learn. Across the project, you'll draw on areas such as: Machine learning and computer vision Sensors and camera modelling State estimation and sensor fusion Control theory Modelling and simulation Low-level programming and hardware/software integration We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these. If you're strong in some and excited to grow into the rest, we'd like to hear from you. What We're Looking For A degree in robotics, electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or a related field - or another engineering background backed by hands-on hardware/software integration work. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead (Energy & Industrials) on our Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution</li> <li>Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.</li> <li>Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.</li> <li>Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.</li> <li>Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Energy & Industrials sector, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within Energy & Industrials (E&I)</li> <li>You bring deep domain expertise in Energy & Industrials (E&I) with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.</li> <li>You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.</li> <li>You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.</li> <li>You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.</li> description: <p><strong>Soho, London <br></strong><strong><em>Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs</em><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a brilliant and motivated Junior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Analytics team. user data and tracking key KPIs.</li> <li>Data Quality & Pipeline Ownership: Collaborate with our Data Engineering teams to automate data ingestion pipelines, ensuring high-quality, model-ready inputs from ad-platforms, attribution tools, and internal databases. </li> <li>Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex econometric, Bayesian, or machine learning concepts into clear, commercial, and highly visual recommendations for marketing team leads and senior leadership. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience or a degree in a highly (pandas, numpy), statistical modeling, and machine learning (we primarily use Python). </li> <li>Strong SQL skills: Comfortable writing efficient, structured queries to extract and aggregate massive datasets from relational databases. </li> <li>MMM Frameworks: Exposure to or strong interest in modern open-source MMM libraries (e.g., Meta's Robyn, Google's Meridian, or PyMC/Bayesian experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, GeoX testing, hypothesis testing, and statistics like MDE and bias analysis). </li> <li> A keen interest in marketing dynamics (customer acquisition, CAC, CPA, ROI, and media attribution).</li> <li>We welcome applications from recent graduates and early career professionals, including candidates who have gained initial experience in an agency or client side environment, ideally with exposure to Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), marketing effectiveness, or related marketing analytics. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What can we offer? </strong></p> <ul> description: <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Customer Success team sits within DoorDash’s In-Store business and serves as a strategic partner to hospitality operators across the UK. as strategic partners to hospitality operators</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About DoorDash</strong></p> <p>At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. </p> <p>DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London OR UK Remote | 💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission) +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨<strong>Fixed-Term 12-month contract 📝</strong></p> <p><strong>*Please note we cannot sponsor visas for this role</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Business Banking team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Monzo Business is on a mission to make banking effortless for small businesses. We help people start, run and grow their businesses with simple, transparent banking and tools that reduce financial admin, so they can spend more time focusing on what matters most.</p> <p>We're launching Monzo Business in Spain, initially focusing on sole traders and simple micro-businesses. While many customers will use a self-serve journey, we know there are moments where speaking to a real person can make all the difference.</p> <p>As our founding Spanish Sales Account Executive, you'll be based in London as part of our UK Sales team, and working closely with Spain Go-To-Market, Product and Marketing teams. You'll combine hands-on sales with gathering customer insight — helping potential customers move forward while shaping the playbook for how Sales can best support our growth in Spain.</p> <p>This is more than just a traditional Sales AE role focused solely on sales conversion. You will also have the opportunity to test, learn and influence how we build a safe, effective and scalable sales motion for Spain from the ground up.</p> <p><br><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with prospective Spanish SMB customers through discovery calls, emails and messaging, and understand their business, challenges, goals and requirements.</li> <li>Be a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services. Explaining Monzo Business's proposition, product capabilities and application process clearly, helping customers understand their next step without providing financial, tax, legal or regulatory advice.</li> <li>Drive full sales cycle, from early prospecting and qualification; to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation. Drive activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up and onboarded.</li> <li>Understand and capture detailed customer objections and feedback. Turn customer conversations into structured and actionable learnings and insights by identifying recurring questions, unmet needs, and journey friction and more.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Go To Market, Product and Marketing teams by collecting, analysing and sharing sales feedback to help teams make rapid and data-driven adjustments</li> <li>Manage a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking. Qualifying and prioritising opportunities, handling objections and following up consistently to help customers progress through their journey.</li> <li>Helping shape our Spain sales playbook, including messaging, qualification, objection handling, scripts and customer journeys. Help create and refine Spanish-language scripts, FAQs, objection handling and sales processes.</li> <li>Deliver outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email, text or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieve sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have hands-on sales experience, ideally as an Account Executive, Sales Development Representative or Business Development Representative, and are comfortable qualifying opportunities, handling objections and following up with customers.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with Spanish culture, customer expectations and communication styles, and the judgement to adapt your approach accordingly.</li> <li>Fluent Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication in both languages.</li> <li>Strong consultative communication skills: you listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions and explain complex topics simply.</li> <li>Ability to build trust with customers who may be unfamiliar with Monzo or uncertain about changing their banking setup.</li> <li>You have experience gathering, structuring and analysing commercial or customer data. You enjoy working cross-functionally and can turn what you're hearing from customers into useful insights for teams such as Product, Marketing, Operations, Risk and Compliance.</li> <li>You have experience selling to or supporting small businesses, ideally within financial services, SaaS or another complex service environment.</li> <li>You're excited by experimentation and comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-changing environment where you'll help shape processes and playbooks as well as follow them.</li> <li>You're highly organised, comfortable working with CRM tools or structured customer data, and bring strong judgement, integrity and customer care to every interaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points if you have experience with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Selling to or supporting Spanish sole traders, micro-businesses or SMEs.</li> <li>Banking, payments or another regulated industry.</li> <li>Selling a new and unfamiliar product to market</li> <li>Customer research, voice-of-customer programmes, sales enablement or GTM experimentation.</li> <li>Background in consultative services. </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍This role can based in our London office or remotely in the UK</p> <p>ℹ️ Please note this will be a 12 month fixed-term-contract</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>20 min recruiter call</li> <li>30 min call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Take home task and in person task review</li> <li>45 min behavioural interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
